title: 5-Minute Chimichurri Sauce
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldKeywords: 5 minute chimichurri sauce, chimichurri cilantro, chimichurri recipe cilantro, easy chimichurri
ldIngredientsRaw: 1/4 cup red onion ((about 1/4 of an onion), chopped*)
1/4 cup olive oil ((substitute aquafaba for oil-free))
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all of the ingredients to a small blender, food processor, or use an immersion blender. Blend everything together, stopping to scrape the sides as needed. I prefer a sauce with lots of visible texture, but if you prefer a smoother sauce, feel free to blend to the desired consistency.
htmlIngredientLines: ▢ ¼ cup red onion, (about ¼ of an onion), chopped*
▢ ¼ cup olive oil, (substitute aquafaba for oil-free)
